name: Miao Pinhong
source:
Yu-Qing and Cocoa's teacher, a Chinese national.

She has seen much discrimination and alienation among people and tries to change the world through education.

Miao quit her job in China and came to Indonesia on her own, just to meet that "person"...

"We're always doing the wrong things... how are we going to tell the kids that to be a grown up is a thing to be proud of?"

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
